statement.text:
Is a p′ -group G locally nilpotent if it admits a splitting automorphism φ of
                                                                       p−1
prime order p such that all subgroups of the form ⟨g, g φ , . . . , g φ ⟩ are nilpotent? An
                                                         2           p−1
automorphism φ of order p is called splitting if gg φ g φ · · · g φ      = 1 for all g ∈ G.
                                                                             A. I. Sozutov
